confirmed_limitations: Pilot validates 24 selected normative architecture objects and does not claim complete digitization of the entire Master Architecture.
The registry is a pilot runtime-readable JSON registry; no new public GPT Action was introduced.
AOT and AOMM remain frozen at v1.0; expansion requires a separately confirmed pilot defect.
verdict: AOMM v1.0 represented all pilot objects without special object-specific models. AOT v1.0 was sufficient for the selected pilot set.
